mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals a tightening monetary policy regime that increases discount rates for equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting central bank hawkishness and reducing equity risk appetite, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases when UNRATE is below 5.0%, or the mean return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential construction starts and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals strong underlying demand growth, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of instances, or the interaction term in a regression model has a non-significant coefficient (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 110.0 (index 2017=100) indicates weakening manufacturing activity and deteriorating economic momentum, which reduces corporate profitability expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 110.0, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) combined with rising housing starts (HOUST) indicates a synchronized surge in consumer and investment demand, which boosts corporate revenue visibility and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The co-movement of RSAFS and HOUST fails to generate positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect in a predictive model is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the CPIAUCSL above 210.0 signals accelerating inflation, which increases the likelihood of further monetary tightening and raises real interest rate expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 210.0, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 150k per month signals strong labor market resilience, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances when PAYEMS exceeds 150k, or the mean return in such periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.5% annualized signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 falls below 1.5%, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
